script_text: The stars are shifting your foundation this week, Aries — and the change hits faster than you expect. Sunday into Monday, Mercury conjunct Neptune in your 8th House surfaces secrets, while Saturn in your 1st House demands authority. Tuesday carries financial pressure as Mars forms a square to Pluto in Aquarius. Wednesday is the pivot — Sun trine Jupiter in your 7th House unlocks love and powerful collaborations overnight. By Friday, Venus enters your 7th House as the Sun hits Libra, making partnerships your entire focus. Career breakthroughs spotlight your 10th House by Sunday, bringing well-deserved recognition. Wednesday is your power day because the Sun trines Jupiter in your 7th House, sparking romance and strategic alliances. Thursday is your hardest day as Mars squares Pluto, dampening your fiery resolve. Protect your wallet early in the week, then open your heart — your instincts are stronger than you realize. Follow for daily updates.
